title: Wanderlust | KEY.co
description_expanded: Wanderlust is a newly constructed coastal haven, thoughtfully designed for families and groups to relax, reconnect, and explore. This contemporary retreat features a private backyard pool and is just a block from the sea, making it the perfect setting for a beachside getaway. With room to sleep twelve comfortably, including a king bedroom on the first floor, and a spacious open-concept design, it offers ample space for everyone to gather. The large kitchen island and dining table for eight invite shared meals and laughter, while a dedicated workspace ensures convenience for those who need to stay connected. You agree to not exceed the maximum number of registered guests listed on your reservation and to leave the Accommodation no later than the check-out date and time that is specified in your confirmation email, unless otherwise agreed upon in writing. If you exceed the maximum number of guests listed on your reservation without approval, Property manager is entitled to require you to vacate and remove from the Accommodation in a manner consistent with applicable law and you may be subject to additional fees.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 3: Single Over Single Bunk + Single Over Double Bunk
